name: Kitsune

actions.name: Foxfire
actions.effect: Spectral blue flames strike the target. On a critical hit, the target is blinded for 1 round.

actions.name: Bewitching Gaze
actions.effect: One humanoid target must pass WILL save or be charmed for 1 minute. The charmed target sees the Kitsune as a trusted ally. Taking damage ends the effect.

actions.name: Illusory Double
actions.effect: Creates an illusory copy of itself or another creature within close range. The illusion lasts until touched or until the Kitsune dismisses it.

reactions.name: Fox's Cunning
reactions.effect: When targeted by a melee attack, the Kitsune can swap places with its illusory double if one exists, causing the attack to miss.

traits.name: Shapechanger
traits.desc: Can assume the form of a fox, a specific humanoid, or its true form (humanoid with fox features) as a free action.

traits.name: Fox Magic
traits.desc: The Kitsune's illusions are supernaturally convincing. Creatures have -1d6 on checks to see through them.

lore: Kitsune are cunning fox spirits from ancient folklore. They grow more tails as they age and gain power, with the eldest having nine tails. They are tricksters by nature but can form deep bonds with mortals they find worthy.
